script: There was one seat on the getaway boat. Jason thought Lucia had finally decided what he was worth. Earlier, they'd stolen the Fixer's payroll chest. His men were closing the road. Lucia stripped the skiff's passenger bench while Jason hauled the chest aboard. He called her plan betrayal. Then he noticed fresh brass filings under the chest. Its padlock was new. Its hinges were not. The Fixer hadn't protected his payroll. He'd locked an anchor chain inside, threaded through the boathouse floor. Jason drove the loose hinge pins out. Lucia pulled the bench free, exposing their skiff's bolt cutters. They cut its thin joining link inside the chest, leaving the heavy chain and empty box behind. Lucia bolted the bench back. Two seats. No score. Jason sat down before she could change her mind.
